paragraphs: Chapter 571
Episode 148. Sword Emperor (3)
In the darkest and deepest abyss on the ground, a cry that illuminates the human heart echoed. The transparent tears of Ron were filled with light.
"Because of me... Because I was deceived."
Dante repeated the same words with blank eyes.
He was not happy, but overwhelmed with guilt at the fact that the two people more precious than his own life, his grandfather and Jin, had come here to save him.
He couldn't stop blaming himself.
While trapped in Gleeak's unconsciousness, Dante felt everything that was happening outside.

Being tied to the abyss, he couldn't scrutinize every situation in detail, but he was clearly aware of the fact that all the terrible things Gleeak tried to do, like killing Ron, collapsing Highran, polluting this land, and swallowing up a friend, were all being realized.
Dante thought all this was because he failed to defeat Gleeak.
If only he had held on, if only he had not fallen, if only he hadn't been fooled at the end, if only he hadn't acted stupid and weak for that one moment…!
He resented himself. It was all his responsibility, but he was so angry that he couldn't even stand on his own, let alone turn everything back.
"Don't say such things, Dante. No one could have done as well as you. The fact that your friend and I were able to come this far is all thanks to you..."
Ron said, wiping Dante's tears.
"So it's okay to rely on your friend and this old man. If not for you, no one would have been able to withstand it."
Dante lost consciousness and could not answer.
His breathing was laborious, his pulse weak, and his body was full of black traces left by the chaos.
But there was no threat to his life. Like Jin, there might be a trace of erosion by chaos, but there were no fatal internal injuries or wounds.
With treatment and rest outside, he could regain his vitality at any time.
There was one thing left to do for that.
To defeat the fifth king of chaos, Gleeak.
Ron lifted Dante onto Jin's back. He felt it. The fact that the last battle of this war was about to begin.
The arrival of Ron and Jin in Gleeak's abyss was also accelerating his awakening.
Originally, the control of unconsciousness should have naturally been taken over by the Black Sea transformation, but due to the two people harassing the abyss, he was awakening faster than expected.
"The attack will start soon. Take Dante and escape in any way."
The end of the abyss began to shake unstably.
A more enormous and fierce energy than the turbulence of chaos they experienced on their way here was shaking the space where they stood.
Although Ron finally ascended to the sky and rescued Dante,
In order to end the war, Gleak must be dealt with. Jin felt sorry for the fate of Ron and Hyran, who still had to fight despite overcoming numerous hardships and deaths.
Kikigigik-!
Chaos was boiling everywhere in the abyss, like a plague. They transformed into swords and spears, constantly stabbing down, but they were blocked by Ron's shield and couldn't enter.
Ron held up his sword, took a stance, and stared at the center of the abyss.
The white stone, having lost its boundary, was vibrating. Ron couldn't take his eyes off the white stone for a moment.
"From now on, I will confront you not as Dante's grandfather, but as Hyran's Sword Emperor..."
Soon, Ron said so and slowly swung Rashid.

Although the black speed falling slowly towards the white stone seemed unstoppable, like the sword of Shiron that Jin had received before becoming a rider, it was carrying the achievement of ascension and its weight.
Jin seemed to see the expression of the white stone facing that sword, Gleak's face. A twisted expression of anger and fear.
On the other hand, of course, there was no longer any madness to be found in Ron.
He had the absolute gaze unique to those who had ascended, such as there was no existence that could break him, nor was there an existence that he could not break.
Crack!
As Ron's sword touched it, a crack occurred in the white stone. Like a cheap gem breaking, it began to scatter into pieces.
The blade continued to slowly cut through the white stone.
Graaaaaaah...!
Then, far away, Gleak's distant scream was heard again. He seemed to be screaming in pain, unable to bear the blade slowly digging into the white stone.

The more Ron focused on Rashid, the stronger the chaos spears pressing against the shield became. Therefore, the shield also gradually narrowed, but there was not a single spear that penetrated and came in.
Gleak seemed to be concentrating all his strength into the abyss.
Jin felt nauseous at the fact that he still had this much power left.
Gleak was also feeling the same emotion towards Ron.
"Lord Ron!"
Jin shouted. It was because he suddenly saw Ron bleeding once.
Right after ascending, the burden on his body from the energy consumed by giving Jin a tenth of his light and breaking through to the abyss.
Ron nodded as if he was okay.

The physical limit is not an obstacle to the ascended knight. Just as chaos was just one form of the Black Sea king, the body of the ascended knight was also just a means of forming his enlightenment.
Even if he vomited blood, Ron's swordsmanship was not disturbed at all. The spilled blood also evaporated into his energy and disappeared without a trace.

By then, there was only about a step's gap left between the protective barrier and the chaotic spears. Either the white stone would split in half first, or the protective barrier would break. Jin was not worried about the latter at all.

True to his expectations, in the end, the blade of Rashid split the white stone in half first. Only the shining trajectory that Ron had slowly drawn and passed through remained where the stone had been floating.
For over a thousand years.
Hyran had been guarding alone, silently, for a long time...
It was the moment when the white stone was finally cut.
And Ron and Jin were able to feel the sensation of the world's light, not the darkness of chaos, irritating their eyes.
Finally, they stepped out of the abyss and returned to the outside. However, the light of the world piercing their eyes was not as bright and brilliant as they had expected.
This was because the sky that should have been bathed in light was still covered by a curtain of chaos. The light was faint, like sparse grass sprouting in a wasteland.
The chaos barrier formed when Glick woke up was stronger than before, and Jin realized that the area was filled with heat and fiery energy.
'Sure enough, was there continuous fighting outside as well?'
A full day had passed outside since Jin and Ron entered Glick's subspace.
And those who had been fighting outside did not know what had happened to the two. They had no way of knowing whether they had been captured or simply vanished.
"Huff, 12th class, huff, 12th class survival confirmed!"
One black knight shouted, catching his breath.
Runcandel had not given up on Jin. However, most of the knights could only think that there was a high possibility that Jin, like Dante who had been absorbed by Glick, did not survive.

Moreover, if they were alive, they should be inside Glick, but without a person with the power of Changsung on the outside battlefield, they couldn't penetrate it. Even removing the chaos barrier protecting Glick by cutting and cutting again was impossible.
And then, unexpectedly, that barrier crumbled by itself and Jin's figure appeared. Even Rosa opened her eyes wide and felt a sense of relief.
Murakan shouted as he rushed towards Jin.
However, because of the chaos spikes springing from the ground, he couldn't easily approach Jin, and Murakan felt as if he was going crazy.
At this point, Murakan was left with only the single idea that no matter what happened next, he had to escape with Jin.

Kellyak also had a similar thought. Even if he negotiated with Kinzelo in the future and solved Glick, he thought he had to secure Jin first and leave the battlefield. Even if the world is at risk of extinction.
"12th class...!"
Rosa also swung her sword and lunged, followed by Kellyak. The bodies of knights and mages were stepped on by them.
Just as worried about Jin as they were, Talalis could not easily approach him. She was barely standing, her body smeared with exhaustion.
It was the price she had to pay for postponing the seal of Elona Zifil so far. Talalis had been fighting without being able to use most of her own power.
The reason Talalis backtracked on the release of Elona Zifil's seal was none other than this.
Ron Hiran.

It was because he had disappeared with Jin. If Ron, that foolish old man, would only come to his senses... there was a glimmer of hope that a miracle might happen again. Talalis thought that she should hold off on unsealing Elona Zifil, even with a grain of hope.
"Little one!"
Rosa, who was heading towards Jin, shouted with a sharp voice. Although there was still a distance of about a hundred steps left, she saw a sudden wave of chaos engulfing Jin.
It was not an energy that Jin could handle. If he couldn't block it, the force would tear him to shreds and he would disappear without a trace.
As everyone trying to save Jin was engulfed in a dreadful and desolate emotion...
Swoosh...!
They witnessed a streak of brilliant sword energy slicing the chaos threatening Jin in half.
Following that, as the tidal wave of chaos receded, they were able to confirm the sight of Dante being carried by him, and Ron Hiran standing tall next to them.
At that point, everyone paused for a moment, doubting their eyes.
Especially giants like Rosa, Kelliak, and Talalis were astounded at the sight of Ron. They even momentarily forgot their urgent intentions towards Jin.
'Ron Hiran, he has ascended to Changseong!'
'Indeed, to Changseong... Moreover, even Dante Hiran...!'
The giants' pulses raced at a breakneck speed.
In the entire history of mankind, less than ten people have gained the power of Changseong, including all those erased from history by the old and present Zifil.
Especially in this era, the giants thought that there could be no other Changseong, because they had a clear benchmark called Shiron.

Because they were certain that the gap between them and him was insurmountable, even if they devoted the rest of their lives to it. Shiron even predicted that it would be more likely for Ron to become a monster than to reach Changseong.
After being blocked, the chaos attacked Jin several times, but each time it was blocked by Ron's sword and turned into foam.
And as he watched the fragments of chaos falling like flesh, Ron said,
"Gleak... there's nothing more for you to take here. Not even your own life."
